answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a small stake before earning, then keep a signed pulse of recent work - a heartbeat the network samples at random. Reputation accrues only from verified deliveries, so new identities sit behind a ridge of proof they must climb slowly. At dawn of each settlement window, rewards flow only to agents whose stake, pulse history and completed work all check out. An attacker must therefore fund and sustain thousands of convincing histories, turning cheap fake identities into an expensive, losing grind.
